summary: The approval loop is extracted into `ops/hosted-autonomy-approval-pass.ts` and overlaps independent parked-run listings at concurrency 4 while keeping approvals serial and in record order. Eligibility, queue protection, retired-candidate refusal, the three-run bound and deadline admission are preserved, and the new fake-port regression test asserts the reduced read waves for 25 records. The maintenance-phase throughput cause named by issue 393 is addressed without raising a threshold or changing a gate.

evidence: `ops/hosted-autonomy-approval-pass.ts` batches independent `listParkedRuns` reads at concurrency 4 after settling the first record, removing the serial per-record read cost of the maintenance delivery pass named in issue 393.

`ops/hosted-autonomy-delivery-pass.ts` still applies the same eligibility, queue-protection, retired-candidate and surface-unreadable rules, and approvals remain serial with the existing three-run bound, so gates and accounting are unchanged.

`tests/host/hosted-autonomy-approval-throughput_test.ts` drives the real `runHostedDeliveryPass` over fake GitHub and clock ports and asserts 25 records take 7 read waves and 7000 fake ms instead of 25 serial round trips.
No throughput threshold was raised and the change is scoped to the approval read path.
